card.name: Mid-sentence words in label eligibility text
card.fires_on: Ordinary connecting words (may, of, or, the, to, no) inside drug-label sentences about which patients are affected, excluded, or dosed. The word is usually just before a patient group, condition, or dosing criterion.

modes.label: Patient-group wording
modes.description: Words in sentences naming who is affected or who a restriction covers.
modes.example: Pregnancy, women who<< may>> become pregnant, and nursing mothers.

modes.label: Dosing and exclusion conditions
modes.description: Small linking words in dose or contraindication rules.
modes.example: For patients weighing 100 kg or more,<< the>> recommended dosage is 30 mg once

card.writes: Pushes toward odd code and Chinese tokens and away from exclusion words like excluded, ineligible, and contraindicated; the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in label sentences about which patients something applies to or is excluded for.
